scripts.lint: eslint index.ts src tests vitest.config.ts vitest.integration.config.ts --parser-options '{"project":[".pi/extensions/sca/tsconfig.test.json"]}' --max-warnings=0
scripts.format: prettier --write README.md index.ts src tests package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json vitest.config.ts vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check README.md index.ts src tests package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json vitest.config.ts vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:all: bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
scripts.build: bun build index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --packages external
